title: View file and directory permissions
summary: Use the ls command with the -l option to see who can read, write, or execute a file or directory. The first column shows the permission bits.

aliases.text: how to see who owns a file

steps.explain: List the contents of a directory in long format to display permissions, owner, and group.

placeholders.name: PATH
placeholders.description: Path to the file or directory you want to inspect.
